text: Warranty claims are about to carry a real dollar amount on every record, so before Devon Okafor builds anything, this lesson plans exactly who should be able to see that.
The plan starts restrictive: Org-Wide Defaults set to Private, because Claim_Amount__c shouldn't be visible to all 150 Cascade Ridge users by default.
Visibility opens back up through role-hierarchy-based sharing, so each region's manager can see their own team's claims -- the actual hierarchy gets built later.
Two permission sets are planned: Service Rep, for creating and editing your own claims, and Service Manager, for reviewing and approving your region's.
Next: planning the automation that routes a new claim to the right regional queue the moment it's created.
